body:
The direct C17 emitter currently refuses the selected §18.1a cleanup call even when ordinary CHECK and source-owned MACHINE/owner/Copy proofs succeed. This change emits the genuine second-original-H terminal receiver, then caller cleanup of the first H, followed by the H2-only named Copy into the same original T and common old/current/sibling reads. H0/H1 never call the receiver or perform the second T write; payload u8(0) remains genuine H2 success.

## Track / scope

Track P; #1525, [C1184 PUBLICATION RELEASE](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1525#issuecomment-6975628006). **DRAFT / HOLD** for required CI, independent final-candidate F/R and C's disposition; P does not self-READY/merge.

Canonical/adopted base: `c97ce81c48a0c003b072c77c655bdeb10860ebf1`, tree `7591cf7c908c9f7258d0d9512fc79d084d73fbaa`, CURRENT_SPEC→Draft17.38, particularly §§3.2,13.5a/c,18.1a,18.2–8,26.9/27.3. This base tree exactly equals reviewed ac6. Final HEAD `7deabd1b1f44bc40862b6a28c89fde502832d8cb`, tree `20083ff35349efd254e015f90dcac38a8d16852a`, contains mechanical re-anchoring commitdca50af1 (tree902527…, exactly matching saved final394d35d) plus one fixture correction: explicitly consume the host-fault diagnostic write's return value. All Production/source/oracle/observer/runner bytes and other24 changed files remain identical. Original commit identities remain preserved.

The private consumer borrows the exact source-authenticated H2 owner call and validates original root/incarnation/full R/Domain, actual/formal/body/result, loan/current and affine consumption through the existing gates. The callee ends/deallocates only the second original; caller cleanup and T identity remain distinct. New tests cover physical original addresses, Domains, closed read scopes and free order as well as public refusals and host rollback.

Supported increment: existing direct two-H mixed H/T lane, one caller-side second-H payload read, exactly one four-step terminal receiver, first-H caller cleanup and same-T named Copy/common continuation. Optional five-step receiver-internal reads, receiver field-index1, arbitrary additional owners/calls/CFG/forwarding, general safe APIs, producer/LiveTail expansion and LLVM lowering remain outside this increment. Existing inline-direct and linked-producer paths keep their original guards. Safety/authority/toolchain/fixed-subject/budget deviations stop affected execution and return to C; no new source law, issuer, API/ABI, checker or T tooling delta is included.

## Historical design audit (§4.2)

- [x] N/A for new selection: faithful implementation of already selected semantics, private consumer/tests/mechanical formatting only.
- [x] Existing DI009/010/017/018/019 basis retained; no new historical design decision or Deferred promotion.
- [x] **KEEP** canonical semantics and public authority; new semantic-selection gate N/A.
- [x] Conservative unsupported source families remain coverage debt, with no authority relaxation or future foreclosure.
- [x] Ledger update not needed: no selected law/source/API change.

## Validation / review

[C1177 local FINAL and exact costs](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1525#issuecomment-6975396857), accepted as bounded local completion by C1184:

| Selection | Actual local result |
| --- | --- |
| Ordinary CHECK and genuine source-owned MACHINE/owner/Copy | Both zero/42 sources succeed under GCC/Clang; public probes under all four configurations |
| P1517 CTests | GCC18/18, pinned Clang18/18, ASan18/18, selected UBSan11/11 |
| Strict GCC/Clang O0/O2 × zero/42 × H0/H1/H2 |24 native PASS |
| Pinned Clang ASan/UBSan, same matrix |24 native PASS; no reached sanitizer diagnostics |
| Source negatives / artifact tamper |7 source refusals (H1 leak precision, other6 semantic), CLI exit3;35 artifact/foreign-origin refusals and pristine retry |
| Host OOM/rollback/no-clobber |6 logical sites,48 fault/retry cases across GCC/Clang/ASan; named sentinel/no-temp and clean retry |
| Old inline/linked regressions |6 GCC inline native +3 Clang ASan linked native; old owned/tamper CTest3/3 |
| Formatting | First formatter RED preserved; pinned mechanical repair and all-C/H check PASS |

Local builds are frontend-only (NO LLVM / PARTIAL infrastructure), not full ordinary CI. UBSan omits the fourth host fault campaign because48/48 local cases are consumed. C1177's historical costs remain local255/320. Current cumulative costs are local276/320, selected native57/64, host6 sites/48 cases, SDK1/2; no local host reinjection. No repeated campaign solely for commit metadata. P-owned tooling uses exact T52f4955 in a separate checkout, the locked SDK SHA5369d292…648b133 and all guards; none of T's patch is included here.

First-HEAD GCC Release [job134747699566](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/44288622393/job/134747699566) failed at fixture compilation: fortified headers mark write's return value warn_unused_result. The original RED/raw and local reproduction are preserved. The final correction assigns that result and discards the local, without warning suppression or any fault/NULL-return/diagnostic change; [complete FIRST and source/SHA](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1525#issuecomment-6976413907). Strict optimized/fortified GCC14 and pinned Clang compile, pinned format, fresh fortified Release targets,10 non-fault CTests and a no-fault CLI emission all pass. No further local host fault path was run.

Final-HEAD natural [FULL5 44290560751](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/44290560751), [PARTIAL 44290560803](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/44290560803) and separate [EARLY2 44290560764](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/44290560764) are **pending at publication**. Both candidate HEADs/16 jobs/6 runs are now used; manual retry/dispatch0 and no third push. First-HEAD successes do not replace final-HEAD validation. Early84-test success alone does not establish receiver sanitizer coverage.

Original P1517 FIRST/RED,80/80,19/36,NOT_RUN and ENV-PARTIAL remain historical. The tracked README/oracle/revalidation document preserve their pre-publication checkpoint status. [Evidence0db02f5](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Evidence/tree/0db02f5088c494d5811e18edb1f15c1537a5cfef) contains the exact saved patches/commits/source/raw, with [full independent HTTPS restore and patch/tree receipt](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1525#issuecomment-6975340901). Independent F/R originals were not read/imported. C owns their final-candidate pin and substantive review; old R1516 is not extended to this boundary.

**VALUE-ALIGNMENT-RISK:** finite cleanup-boundary capability does not establish an ordinary-safe library/all safe-reachable states or smaller author+ordinary-safe-caller UB audit/re-audit closure versus well-factored C. Benefit is UNMEASURED; sound Rust ownership/Drop/safe facade remains a fair alternative. Product GO624 PAUSED / H1 HOLD. No new fixture-specific trusted mechanism beyond the saved bounded consumer.
